basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old science enthusiast living in Portland, Oregon. My day job involves working as a lab assistant at a local university, where I help set up experiments and manage lab equipment. In my free time, I love exploring new hobbies, like creating my own fragrances and playing indie video games. I'm passionate about animal rights and enjoy engaging in discussions about ethical treatment of animals. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, between 7 PM and 10 PM. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in chemistry, which fuels my interest in DIY fragrance creation and understanding scientific concepts like centrifugal force. I am mostly self-taught when it comes to video games and indie game development, often learning through online forums and YouTube tutorials.
